en: The postcard shows a sepia-toned photograph of a rural scene with a group of women, dressed in traditional peasant attire, sitting on the ground and surrounded by corn husks. They appear to be husking corn as part of a communal agricultural activity. Behind them is a wooden cart pulled by oxen, with a man standing beside the animals holding a tool. The background shows a field with trees. There is printed text at the top and bottom of the postcard.
